column1: # Supported pickup / delivery towns used for distance and zone pricing.
# code       stable identifier sent by clients (upper case
# district   the "zone": a delivery between different districts pays the zone surcharge
# latitude / longitude   approximate town-centre coordinates in decimal degrees (WGS84)
# DATA QUALITY: coordinates are a starter set drafted by hand to about 0.01 degrees (roughly 1 km). They MUST be
# reviewed against an authoritative source (e.g. GeoNames or OpenStreetMap) before production use
# they directly determine delivery fees. Changing a value changes quotes; see docs/pricing.md.
